# NXExtract provenance

prebuilt AArch64 UI from:

- repository: <https://github.com/NextOs-Ports/NXExtract>
- source commit: `df3f68e7a1c09ba38fa0b18b5ace713a9739cee0`
- release: <https://github.com/NextOs-Ports/NXExtract/releases/tag/v1.1.1>
- UI SHA-256:
